Research code has a habit of being written once, understood for about a week,
and then becoming unreadable to its own author. These pages are the antidote:
each one explains what a tool does, the reasoning behind how it does it, and
how to run it.

Where it helps, the examples are live — you can edit the code in the page and
run it without installing anything.
